description: Custom calendar editor toolbar bridge with stable editorId context and editor-targeted read/write APIs.

attendees.description: Serialized ATTENDEE properties from the live unsaved editor.

availabilityInterval.description: Live resource availability interval in UTC milliseconds, with an exclusive end and the event time zone. All-day and floating events use the calendar default time zone.

types.description: Replace live attendees only while the before snapshot still matches. Ordinary attendees remain unchanged except for an explicit CUTYPE-only promotion to ROOM or RESOURCE. Other additions and changes are limited to room/resource attendees.

discarded: emitted for dialogcancel, dialogextra2, or unload. superseded: tracked editorId was replaced by a new editorId for the same UI target. Persisted items are reported by calendar.items.onCreated or calendar.items.onUpdated instead of this editor-close event.
Underlying UI signal that produced the close action.
Lifecycle payload for one tracked editorId emitted by onTrackedEditorClosed.

events.name: onClicked
events.description: Fired when the ncCalToolbar button is clicked in an editor window and includes a stable editorId plus the current iCal and/or live editor snapshot.

events.name: onTrackedEditorClosed
events.description: Fired for tracked editors only, after getCurrent() or updateCurrent() has been called for that editorId. Emitted once per tracked editorId. action reflects the exact close signal defined by EditorClosedAction and reason. No ordering guarantee relative to other calendar change notifications.

functions.name: getCurrent
functions.description: Get the current item for the editor identified by editorId. Returns null if that editor is no longer open or if no editable item can be resolved in that editor. The snapshot may contain iCal, live editor fields, or both.

functions.name: updateCurrent
functions.description: Update the current item for the editor identified by editorId. Requires an update via fields, properties, or attendees. Requested targets and attendee permissions are checked before writing. Field, property, and attendee changes roll back together on failure. This only edits the open draft; it never saves or sends the event.
